gist: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。 へ marks direction toward a place. Pronounce へ as え. For movement, へ and に often both work: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます ≈ [学校|がっこう]に[行|い]きます. Time expressions use only に (×七時へ).

rows: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
[駅|えき]へ[行|い]きます。 ≈ [駅|えき]に[行|い]きます。
formation.note: Written へ, spoken え. For go/come/return, へ and に are usually interchangeable. へ slightly highlights the direction toward; に is the everyday destination marker you just learned.

explanation: へ points you toward a place: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます, [日本|にほん]へ[来|き]ます, うちへ[帰|かえ]ります. Say it as え, not "he." With movement verbs, [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます and [学校|がっこう]に[行|い]きます are both natural. Keep using で for where you act and を for objects after you arrive. Clock times and weekdays take に only — not へ (七時に / ×七時へ).

senses.label: Direction of going
senses.body: Place + へ + [行|い]きます — toward that place.
senses.example_ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
senses.example_en: I go to school. / I head to school.

senses.label: Direction of coming / returning
senses.body: Same へ with [来|き]ます and [帰|かえ]ります.
senses.example_en: I come to Japan. / toward Japan.

senses.label: Pronunciation え
senses.body: The particle is written へ but pronounced え.

senses.label: Overlap with destination に
senses.body: For movement, へ and に usually both work; pick either in class.
senses.example_ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。 / [学校|がっこう]に[行|い]きます。

senses.label: Preview: time takes に only
senses.body: Movement allows へ or に. Clock times take に only (七時に), never ×七時へ.
senses.example_ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
senses.example_en: Direction OK with へ; time uses に, not へ.

register_context: Polite classroom movement with へ / に. Pronounce へ as え. Either particle is fine for go/come/return in this course; learn the overlap rather than treating one as "more correct."

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [学校|がっこう]を[行|い]きます。
mistakes.right_ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
mistakes.why: Movement takes へ or に — not object を.

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [行|い]きますへ[学校|がっこう]。
mistakes.right_ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
mistakes.why: へ attaches to the place noun before the verb.

mistakes.wrong_ruby: (Pronouncing へ as "he") [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
mistakes.right_ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
mistakes.why: へ is pronounced え (学校え行きます), not "he."

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [学校|がっこう]で[行|い]きます。
mistakes.right_ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
mistakes.why: で is place of action; direction/destination uses へ or に.

contrasts.label: へ vs に for movement
contrasts.summary: 学校へ行きます ≈ 学校に行きます. Both mark where you are headed; へ leans toward "direction," に toward "destination."
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [学校|がっこう]に[行|い]きます。

contrasts.label: へ (direction) vs で (action place)
contrasts.summary: 学校へ行きます = head to school. 学校で勉強します = study at school.
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [学校|がっこう]で[勉強|べんきょう]します。

contrasts.label: Movement へ/に vs time に only
contrasts.summary: For going, both へ and に work. For clock times, only に: 七時に / ×七時へ.
contrasts.ex_a_en: I go to the station. (へ OK)
contrasts.ex_b_en: I go to the station. (に OK for movement; time uses に only)

contrasts.label: に vs へ contrast lesson
contrasts.summary: へ and に both mark movement destinations; time takes only に (七時に — never ×七時へ).
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
contrasts.ex_b_en: I get up at seven. (time に only)

examples.ruby: [学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。

examples.english: I go home. / I head home.

examples.ruby: カフェへ[行|い]きます。コーヒーを[飲|の]みます。
examples.english: I go to a café. I drink coffee.

examples.ruby: [図書館|としょかん]へ[行|い]きます。[本|ほん]を[読|よ]みます。
examples.english: I go to the library. I read a book.

examples.ruby: [友達|ともだち]も[学校|がっこう]へ[行|い]きます。
examples.english: My friend goes to school too.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.ruby: [駅|えき]へ[行|い]きます。それからカフェでコーヒーを[飲|の]みます。
dialogue.english: I'm going to the station. Then I'll drink coffee at a café.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.ruby: はい、うちへ[帰|かえ]ります。

checks.why: Direction toward school → 学校へ行きます (に also OK; を is wrong).

checks.prompt: How do you pronounce へ in 学校へ行きます?
Context: I go to the station (direction へ).
For movement, 学校へ行きます and 学校に行きます are…
checks.why: Both particles work for movement destinations/directions.
Return direction → うちへ帰ります (うちに also OK).
